page.layout: One column of text on a single printed page. No marginal notes. Page number and running head at the top. Catchword "duel-" at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: quæ quod auctoritate aut potentiâ omnessubditos, præfer-tim potentiores, & maxime factiosos in officio continere non poterant, nec gladio ju-stitiæ coercere audebant, si forte deliquissent, simultates & inimicitias inter illos per artes quasdam foverunt. Tandemque passi sunt eos in se mutuo irruere, singulari instituto certamine; præsertim cum ferocientes vel quasvis duellorum occasiones captarent. Atque ita cum tales invicem essent carnifices, ab illis otiosis, & factiosis hominibus respublica liberabatur, ac Principis tranquillitati magis erat consultum.
Tertia occasio est, præsumptæ gloriæ cupido, cujus adeo appetens est homo, ut mori satius ducat, quàm ejus non esse particeps. Omnes enim, qui non rectè omnia expendunt,

page.notes: Printing as seen: "omnessubditos" is printed without a space; "deliquissent", "simultates" and "subditos" read with long s as plain s. The spelling "præfer-tim" at the line end and "præsertim" later on the page are both as printed; the second may be "præsertim" with a long s. "Principis" and "tranquillitati" as printed. The ink mark at the right margin beside "duellorum" and the faint lower-right mark are stains or digitiser marks, not text.
